site_year_eligibility: at least one non-NA psma survey result
at least one non-NA perc_surveyed value

stage_classes.adult: any normalized A token observed in site-year
stage_classes.reproductive: any normalized E or L token observed in site-year

interpretation_boundary: 0 means no evidence of that stage in the eligible repeated-survey site-year, not proven biological absence

fish_state.not_observed: at least one N and no Y
fish_state.unknown: all NA or blank; excluded from fish interaction model

primary_model.formula: stage_evidence ~ reproductive_stage + fish_present + reproductive_stage:fish_present + year_centered + max_effort + n_visits + depth_class
primary_model.directional_hypothesis: negative: fish presence disproportionately reduces reproductive-stage evidence relative to adult-stage evidence

secondary_model.formula: stage_evidence ~ reproductive_stage + year_centered + reproductive_stage:year_centered + max_effort + n_visits + depth_class
secondary_model.interpretation: long-term divergence of reproductive-stage evidence relative to adult-stage evidence

fallback_if_fish_gate_fails: secondary temporal stage-divergence model becomes confirmatory without inspecting effect direction
forbidden_claims: reproductive failure for a site-year with no E/L evidence
